mach_conduit_run.design: Design 1 §19.5 five conduit states, pinned by Design 6 §19; Design 3 §33.8 in-world readability

how_to_drive.audio: NOT SUPPLIED. §19.5's hum, arrival click and rising pitch do not exist in this kit.
how_to_drive.fill: scale the band node on X from its -X end for `delayed`; the texture does not move
how_to_drive.lever: rotate `lever_arm` about its own X axis; the pivot sits at the arm's base
how_to_drive.material_slots: each named node also owns exactly one material slot, so `set_surface_override_material(0, m)` on the NODE is enough for a texture swap
how_to_drive.named_nodes: every state region is its own node under the asset root; fetch it by name and drive it directly
how_to_drive.scroll: set `uv1_offset.x` on the band's material for `active` and `pulse_travelling`

mach_conduit_run.status: PROPOSAL -- presentation only; no signal graph, no node types, no gameplay state machine
